name: OpenMausBot
description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
one_liner: A chat app where each 'contact' is actually an AI assistant with its own personality, its own computer, and access to your apps — like texting a small team of employees.
buyer: A solo agency owner or one-person operator who wants several specialized AI 'employees' (support, research, scheduling) without hiring staff or stacking up SaaS subscriptions.
business_use_cases: A one-person agency sets up bot 'employees' to handle client support DMs and invoice follow-ups, then bills clients for the output those bots produce.
A software consultancy resells branded 'AI staff' chat setups to small-business clients who want automation but can't build it themselves.
A solo founder runs a bot with its own cloud computer and connected apps to handle social-media posting and customer replies overnight.

money_ideas.idea: Managed 'AI employee' setup and hosting service for small businesses
One-off custom bot configuration for a client's specific workflow

steal_this: Configure one bot persona that handles a single real task (answering a shop's FAQ DMs) for a local business this weekend and charge a flat monthly fee to keep it running.
